answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint soft IDs that spiral through attest graphs before bonds settle. Mechanism: lock 0.28 POA in a 36h vault and gather four whisper-tagged vouchers from invite-distance ≥2 peers; each is H=sha256(epoch|addr|slot|salt) spaced 75–150s. Spiral-gate: weight accrues only if ≥2 non-overlapping vouch lineages countersign distinct slots while the vault stays sealed. Cost: bond plus ~8 min peer clocks. Verification: nullifier(epoch,addr) and four H digests ride the attest batch. Failure: reused salt, lineage overlap, or gap-cheat burns the vault and zeros that epoch weight.
